name: deployment-activity
goal: Show concurrent dev, stage, preprod and prod deployments in a top-right activity panel with shared progress and detail components.

evidence: Specified top-right activity, shared components, host-wide background jobs, per-target ordering, captured source proof and atomic receipts before implementation.
Implemented host-wide per-target queues, isolated captured sources, atomic receipts, activity light and shared deployment progress/details. Local provider tests and affected browser flows pass.

Baseline UI and concurrency failures reproduced before product changes. Focused backend 30/30, permissions 6/6, shared impact 13/13, component/store 5/5 and browser 8/8 pass; fresh screenshots inspected.

Every required verification stage passed: initial root stages through Planning; complete Desktop 874 tests and 178 acceptance cases, Collaboration, Hub, Remote and Relay. Two initial integration timeouts passed unchanged on isolated and full reruns. Removed one obsolete comment to satisfy remote file size. Final format and registry checks pass.
